meta.name: Signature Style
meta.edition: Harmonized — 100% official Catppuccin, per-theme (Mocha dark / Latte light)

mocha.description: Harmonized dark theme — 100% official Catppuccin Mocha: structural base/surface/text plus the signature Mocha Flamingo/Teal accents, every value straight from the official palette.

--bg-base.name: --bg-base
--bg-base.description: Catppuccin Mocha base — page and app background.

--bg-surface.name: --bg-surface
--bg-surface.description: Mocha surface0 — cards, inputs, secondary buttons, disabled surfaces.

--color-cake-primary.name: --color-cake-primary
--color-cake-primary.description: Catppuccin Mocha Flamingo — primary actions. Official palette color; per-theme harmony means the dark side of the toggle wears Mocha's own accent.

--color-cake-secondary.name: --color-cake-secondary
--color-cake-secondary.description: Catppuccin Mocha Teal — focus rings and secondary accents. Official palette color; per-theme harmony means the dark side of the toggle wears Mocha's own accent.

--text-muted.name: --text-muted
--text-muted.description: Mocha overlay0 — subtitles, hints, disabled labels.

--bg-inset.name: --bg-inset
--bg-inset.description: KEEPER — legacy deep grey. Inset wells, code blocks, input interiors.

--text-bright.name: --text-bright
--text-bright.description: KEEPER — legacy off-white. Maximum-contrast emphasis text and headings.

--color-success.name: --color-success
--color-success.description: KEEPER — legacy soft mint. Success actions.

--text-muted-soft.name: --text-muted-soft
--text-muted-soft.description: KEEPER — legacy dimmed blue. Tertiary text, quiet captions.

--color-cake-secondary.name: --color-cake-secondary
--color-cake-secondary.description: Catppuccin Latte Teal — focus rings and secondary accents. Official palette color; per-theme harmony means the light side of the toggle wears Latte's own accent, not Mocha's.

sigPalette.description: The Chromatic Palette (0.4.0; 3.0.0 THE 16-COLOR CHROMATIC EXPANSION) — theme-independent CONTENT colors, defined once in :root and inherited by both Mocha and Latte untouched. 26 tokens: the 10 legacy + cobalt (blue retired, value carried) + the 15 chromatic fills.
sigPalette.ruleOfEngagement: RULE OF ENGAGEMENT: --sig-* tokens are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for content — badges, tags, avatars, event theme overrides, calendar blocks, data visualization. The Engine continues using Flamingo/Teal (--color-cake-primary / --color-cake-secondary) for ALL structural UI actions — buttons, inputs, focus rings. Never use --sig-* for structural chrome; never use Flamingo/Teal for content categories.

doctrine.token_cascade: One token in, four states out. Hover lightens (color-mix … 85%, white), active darkens (… 85%, black) and presses (scale 0.97), disabled grays out (--bg-surface + --text-muted), focus rings 2px solid --color-cake-primary. You never write a state hex code.
doctrine.override_protocol: Overrides are the Golden Weapon: scoped utility classes (.override-*) that alter ONE component locally. They define their own full state set and never touch :root. Danger keeps the owner's bright red #FF6B6B; gold keeps #FFD700→#DAA520.
doctrine.grid_8px: The 8px grid: --space-tight (0.5rem) / --space-standard (1rem) / --space-section (1.5rem) for all padding and gaps. Maximize negative space. Borders are 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 20%, transparent). Radius is 6px. Zero drop shadows anywhere.
doctrine.themes: Default is Catppuccin Mocha (dark). The white version is Catppuccin Latte: opt in with <html data-theme="latte">. Keeper tokens carry legacy palette colors across editions with semantic jobs. HARMONIZED DOCTRINE (0.3.0): 100% official Catppuccin, per-theme — the dark toggle wears Mocha Flamingo (#F2CDCD) / Mocha Teal (#94E2D5), the light toggle wears Latte Flamingo (#DD7878) / Latte Teal (#179299). No cross-theme imports; harmony by construction.
doctrine.pillars: Four structural pillars (0.3.0): (1) Iconography — Lucide-React exclusively, 2px stroke matching Inter weight 500, never mix icon libraries; (2) Breakpoints — strict mobile shift at max-width: 768px, all multi-column grids collapse to a single column; (3) Z-Index Scale — sticky/toolbars z-10 (--z-sticky), dimming overlays/backdrops z-40 (--z-overlay), modals/popups/dropdowns z-50 (--z-modal); (4) Edge States — loading is a pulsing-opacity skeleton on --bg-surface, empty is a --bg-surface card with a Lucide icon and --text-muted text, centered.
